name: superskillret
description: Embedding-based skill retrieval for Claude Code. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool and injects them as context. v0.3.3 makes /plugin update apply automatically: the daemon ping reply now carries its plugin version, and on mismatch the next prompt's hook gracefully shuts down the old daemon and spawns the new one — so a SUPERSKILLRET_SCOPE change (or any future boot-time setting) takes effect on the next prompt instead of being silently ignored until manual /superskillret:stop. Also fixes a SIGTERM cleanup bug that caused zombie-daemon cascades when killing a stale non-owner daemon, and migrates the user-added skill pool from the previous version's cache so /plugin update doesn't lose user-curated skills. v0.3.2 adds SUPERSKILLRET_SCOPE env var to restrict retrieval to the user pool (or system pool) — set "SUPERSKILLRET_SCOPE": "user" in a project's .claude/settings.json env block to retrieve only from your /superskillret:add curated set. v0.3.1: /superskillret:setup brings the plugin to a fully-ready state synchronously (install.sh + daemon spawn + verification) with live progress, so you don't waste 1-2 prompts on the lazy-fork wait notices. v0.3.0 PLUGIN_ROOT uses CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT first with clear fallback. v0.2.9 Python 3.9 compat. v0.2.8 daemon health line + list/remove cli. v0.2.0–0.2.7 custom skill registration + UX fixes.
